runtime.noticeText:
# Bundled theme licenses

Community themes are pruned copies of pinned Zed theme files or conversions of
the pinned Shiki TextMate files listed below. Theme names and appearances are
normalized to Shiki's catalog.

## Sources

Terminal palettes use the same pinned sources as the themes below. Exceptions:

- Horizon's original repository is unavailable. Its palette comes from the
  [Zed Horizon 0.0.1 archive](https://api.zed.dev/extensions/horizon/0.0.1/download).
- Andromeeda's two null black entries and both Horizon themes' four null black
  and white entries use their inherited
  [Zed defaults at `ce48461`](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/ce48461eaadd16c65c31f835511ab96bd3b6e746/crates/theme/src/default_colors.rs).
- LaserWave leaves ten terminal colors undefined; Slack Dark leaves all 16
  undefined. These entries use the dark palette in
  [VS Code at `3623f17`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/3623f170559712f7ee16f59dfbd87c885b6a2b31/src/vs/workbench/contrib/terminal/common/terminalColorRegistry.ts).
- Pierre's palettes come from
  [its Zed theme](https://github.com/pierrecomputer/pierre/blob/861ce3c61e1cfeaf283d83e95a3767479e75bfee/packages/theme/zed/themes/pierre.json).
  The vibrant variants preserve the Display P3 values in
  [Pierre Dark Vibrant](https://github.com/pierrecomputer/pierre/blob/861ce3c61e1cfeaf283d83e95a3767479e75bfee/packages/theme/themes/pierre-dark-vibrant.json)
  and
  [Pierre Light Vibrant](https://github.com/pierrecomputer/pierre/blob/861ce3c61e1cfeaf283d83e95a3767479e75bfee/packages/theme/themes/pierre-light-vibrant.json).

Dracula's `ffffffff` bright white value is normalized to `#ffffffff`.

The Zed version is the extension version published in the
[Zed registry](https://github.com/zed-industries/extensions) at
`ab756766c27fca3de3d275149f6937105f464dec`. "Built in" means the theme ships
with Zed itself. GitHub-only sources have no marketplace version.

This project includes some code derived from

implementation. We have since written our own core at `packages/path-store`, but
many of the best ideas from `headless-tree` made their way to `path-store` and
`trees`. It's hard to identify exactly which code this is at this point, but
definitely things like the drag and drop implementation and the general list

programs.name: Git
programs.description: The daemon runs your installed git as a separate program for every read. octopus-diff does not bundle or link it.

programs.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
programs.description: Optional. When installed and signed in, the daemon runs it for read-only pull request queries (docs/FORGES.md). octopus-diff does not bundle it and never reads its token.

programs.name: GitLab CLI (glab)
programs.description: Optional. When installed and signed in, the daemon runs it for read-only merge request queries (docs/FORGES.md). octopus-diff does not bundle it and never reads its token.

adapted.name: T3 Code

files.what: The path rules of the command-palette browse mode.
The auth-status host parser, adapted from packages/source-control-gitlab/src/server/gitLabAuthStatus.ts.
The check-status mapping and the "unfinished runs outrank finished ones" dedupe, adapted from toCheckStatus / toCheckEntries in packages/source-control-github/src/server/gitHubPullRequestJson.ts.
Checks grouping and the status-line wording, adapted from groupPullRequestChecks / describePullRequestChecks in apps/web/src/components/pullRequest/pullRequestDetail.logic.ts.
visibleBody (HTML comments stripped before rendering), from apps/web/src/components/pullRequest/pullRequestDetail.logic.ts.
The hidden-textarea clipboard fallback, adapted from writeTextWithExecCommand / writeTextToClipboard in apps/web/src/hooks/useCopyToClipboard.ts.

Diff lines of a selected range and the fence language by extension, adapted from buildDiffReviewLines / inferReviewCommentFenceLanguage / formatReviewCommentFence in apps/web/src/reviewCommentContext.ts.
Copy feedback (copied state, check icon, anchored "Copied!" toast), modelled on useCopyToClipboard, DiffFilePathCopyButton and anchoredCopyToast.
Placement of the floating Copy bar next to the pointer, after resolveSelectionActionPosition in apps/web/src/lib/selectionActions.ts.

adapted.design: The sidebar (folders, the Settled shelf, settling by hand), the folder picker and the command palette's browse mode are modelled on T3 Code's UI. The forge integration (remote recognition, CLI-login refinement for self-hosted hosts, the GitHub base-repository order, the merge request fields and PR glyphs) follows T3 Code's source-control packages.
